checks.text: The page shows the heading "Vocabulary Builder" and the tab labels "Deck" and "Study".

On the Deck tab, typing "serendipity" in the field labelled "Word", "happy accident" in the field labelled "Definition", and clicking the button "Add word" adds a list item containing "serendipity" and "happy accident".

After adding "serendipity" and "ephemeral" (definition "short-lived"), clicking the tab "Study" shows a card with "serendipity" on the front; clicking the button "Flip" reveals "happy accident" on the back.
On the Study tab with the card "serendipity" flipped, clicking the button "Again" removes "serendipity" from the current session queue and shows the text "1 card due".
On the Study tab with the card "serendipity" flipped, clicking the button "Good" shows the text "1 card due" and the card "serendipity" is no longer in the current session.
After grading "serendipity" as "Good" and "ephemeral" as "Again", the Study tab shows the text "Session complete" and the button "Review due" is visible.
On the Deck tab, clicking the button "Delete ephemeral" removes the list item containing "ephemeral" and "short-lived".
After adding "serendipity" and "ephemeral", clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard that contains the line "serendipity,happy accident".
Reload keeps the word "serendipity" with definition "happy accident" in the Deck tab list.
